title: Build an Array With Stack Operations
summary: Given an integer array target and an integer n, you have an empty stack with push and pop operations.
statement: Given an integer array target and an integer n, you have an empty stack with push and pop operations. You receive a stream of integers from 1 to n. Use these operations to match the stack contents to the target array. Always push the next integer from the stream to the stack if the stream is not empty. Pop the top integer if the stack is not empty. Stop when the stack matches the target array. Return the sequence of stack operations.
constraints: Read integers 1 through n in order; Push reads one and Pop removes the current top.
Stop as soon as the strictly increasing target is built.
hints: Read each value only through the largest target value.
If the value is absent from target, immediately append Pop.
Target is increasing, so retained streamed values exactly form it and later input is unnecessary.
editorial: Target is increasing, so retained streamed values exactly form it and later input is unnecessary.

tests.explanation: Push one; push then pop two; push three.
Every streamed value belongs to target, so only three Push operations are needed.
